ui.name: collapsible
ui.summary: Renders a button plus the region it controls.
ui.guidance: Unlike Disclosure this is for a region whose trigger sits elsewhere in the layout - a filter panel toggled from a toolbar, for instance. The trigger carries aria-expanded and aria-controls, and the region uses the `hidden` attribute rather than a class so it is removed from the accessibility tree and from tab order when closed.
